Descriptions: Modest and athletic, a size that is practical for her active lifestyle and doesn't hinder movement.

Details.Name: Shape
Descriptions: Firm and naturally shaped, with pale pink areolae that contrast with her sun-kissed skin.

Disadvantages: Can be naive due to her young age.
Sometimes prioritizes scientific discovery over immediate safety.

Description: A small, practical knife for cutting ropes and taking samples.
Waterproof field journal and pencils.
Sample collection jars and bags.
Full set of professional diving equipment.
A small, lightweight harpoon for spearfishing.

Notes: The youngest crew member, serving as Deckhand and resident Marine Biologist.

Birth.BirthDateTime: Year of the Iron Serpent, 12th cycle, Day of the Great Gear

Naked: Stocky, muscular build from years of working a forge. The transition from flesh to his metal prosthetic at the left elbow is stark.
Story: Kaelen lost his arm in a workshop accident that also claimed the life of his mentor. He designed and built his own replacement, becoming one of the most skilled, if not the most personable, artificers in Cogsworthy. He now runs his own shop, taking on complex commissions that others deem impossible.
Residence: A large workshop and living quarters in the Gear-Tooth District of Cogsworthy.

BodyMarks.Name: Forge Scars
BodyMarks.Description: A web of faint burn scars covering his right hand and forearm from a forge accident.

BodyMarks.Name: Brow Scar
BodyMarks.Description: A jagged, silvery scar cutting vertically through his left eyebrow.

Details.Name: Clockwork Arm
Descriptions: A masterfully crafted prosthetic replacing the original limb from the elbow down.
Constructed from polished brass, copper wiring, and hardened steel.
Fingers are fully articulated and capable of fine manipulation, though they emit soft clicks and whirs.
A practical, short cut, often unruly and flecked with soot from the forge.
Mainly a dark, raven black, but heavily streaked with iron-gray at the temples and crown, betraying his age and stress.
Details.Name: Style and Color

Descriptions: Coarse and thick, perpetually feeling slightly gritty from airborne metal dust in his workshop.
Details.Name: Texture

Descriptions: A strong, somewhat square shape with a solid jawline.
His forehead is etched with deep lines of concentration, and a small, silvery scar sits just above his left eyebrow from a slipped gear.
Details.Name: Shape and Features

Descriptions: A piercing, steely gray that seems to analyze everything for its flaws and potential.
Details.Name: Color

Descriptions: Deep-set and sharp, framed by crow's feet carved from years of squinting into the bright light of his forge and at intricate blueprints.
Details.Name: Shape

Descriptions: A strong, straight bridge with a slight crook to the left, the result of a long-forgotten brawl in his youth.
Details.Name: Shape

Descriptions: Unremarkable in shape, but the tops of the helixes are slightly calloused and darkened from the heat of the forge.
Details.Name: Appearance

Descriptions: Thin lips that are habitually pressed into a firm, straight line of disapproval or concentration.
The corners are permanently turned slightly downwards, giving him a grumpy resting face.
Details.Name: Shape and Expression

Descriptions: Thick and muscular, a solid pillar supporting his head, with prominent tendons that stand out when he is exerting himself or arguing a price.
Details.Name: Build

Descriptions: Broad and powerful, yet noticeably asymmetrical.
His right shoulder is heavily muscled, while the left is a hardened nexus of scarred tissue and polished steel where his prosthetic arm is mounted.
Details.Name: Symmetry and Build

Descriptions: His remaining right arm is a corded mass of muscle, tanned and crisscrossed with a roadmap of old, silvery burn scars.
A fine layer of dark hair and soot often covers his forearm.
Details.Name: Right Arm (Organic)

Descriptions: His left arm is a masterwork of artifice, crafted from darkened iron and burnished brass. Exposed pistons hiss faintly with movement, and polished copper wiring is visible beneath plates of steel. It is a tool of function, not beauty.
Details.Name: Left Arm (Prosthetic)

Descriptions: The right hand is large and calloused, with knuckles like walnuts. The skin is rough and stained with oil and metal dust.
His grip is incredibly strong, capable of both delicate adjustments and crushing force.
Details.Name: Right Hand (Organic)

Descriptions: A fully articulated prosthetic of interlocking metal plates. The fingertips are interchangeable, often switching between a precise pincer grip and a hardened striking surface. It moves with a series of quiet, deliberate clicks.
Details.Name: Left Hand (Prosthetic)

Descriptions: On his right hand, the nails are short, thick, and often chipped, with a permanent, dark crescent of grease and grime embedded underneath.
Details.Name: Fingernails (Organic)

Descriptions: His prosthetic hand features stylized nail plates made of sharpened, hardened steel, which he uses for scribing marks onto metal plates.
Details.Name: Fingernails (Prosthetic)

Descriptions: A broad, powerful chest with the well-developed pectoral muscles of a blacksmith.
A large, puckered burn scar spreads across the left side of his chest, disappearing under the mounting for his prosthetic arm—a permanent reminder of his accident.
Details.Name: Build and Markings

Descriptions: Not lean, but solid. He has a firm, powerful core built from years of swinging a hammer and controlling heavy machinery, what some might call a 'power gut'.
Details.Name: Build

Descriptions: Sturdy and solid, providing a stable base of operations for all his work. The leather straps of the harness for his prosthetic wrap around his torso and anchor here, showing wear on his trousers.
Details.Name: Structure

Descriptions: Thick and powerful, especially his thighs, conditioned by decades of standing, bracing, and operating foot-pedals on various forge equipment.
Details.Name: Musculature

Descriptions: Broad and calloused, usually encased in heavy, steel-toed leather work boots.
The soles are tough from a life spent on hard stone floors.
Details.Name: Appearance

Descriptions: Befitting a man of his age and pragmatic nature; unremarkable and purely functional. The surrounding hair is dark and coarse, with traces of gray.
Details.Name: Appearance

Favorites.FavoritePlant: None, they don't grow well with all the soot.

Talents: Can diagnose a machine's malfunction purely by the sound it makes.
Has an intuitive understanding of complex mechanical systems.

Description: A roll of custom-made tools, each perfectly balanced and maintained.
A small, intricate clockwork bird that flits around his workshop and sometimes follows him through the city.

Notes: Believes that tangible, reliable machinery is superior to the fickle and dangerous magic practiced by those in the celestial cities above.
